title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.13025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. translated_title: Evo²：通过权重与框架协同进化实现进化器的进化
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体越来越多地被用于在无需人工干预的情况下改进语言模型系统，其途径包括权重更新或框架改进。现有方法通常将这两个方向分开处理：一些方法利用自生成的经验来更新模型权重，另一些方法则重写定义智能体如何使用提示、工具、上下文和执行反馈的框架。然而，这些方法忽略了模型权重与智能体框架之间的关系。为了将这两个过程联系起来并确保有效且平滑的智能体自我进化，我们提出了 Evo²，一个权重-框架协同进化框架。在框架更新方面，我们设计了一个统一的双角色流水线，即由单一策略同时担任“提议者”和“反思者”两种角色，前者负责撰写框架修改，后者负责诊断修改效果并指导修订。在权重更新方面，框架修改及其执行结果被用于指导模型的训练。
tldr: 提出了权重-框架协同进化框架 Evo²，让单一策略同时担任提议者和反思者来完成框架的自我修改，并利用框架修改及其执行结果指导模型权重训练，从而实现智能体权重与框架的联合进化。
en_tdlr: Evo² enables weight-harness co-evolution by having a single policy act as both Proposer and Reflector for harness edits, while harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide weight training, jointly evolving both the model weights and the agent harness.
